description: A Role — a named set of actions a share or invite grants. The platform's Roles collection holds the roles offered; Mantle reads them each time, so an edited or added Role is offered at once.

role.description: the name a share or invite gives

actions.description: the CRUDEASIO actions the role grants: create, read, update, delete, evict, invoke, add, share, admin
